title: Docker & Containers Essentials
description: Package and ship reproducible apps anywhere with Docker. Master images vs. containers, Dockerfiles, layer caching, volumes, networks, and Docker Compose.
outcomes: Understand the difference between immutable Docker images and running containers
Run, inspect, debug, and stop containers cleanly with docker run, logs, and exec
Author optimized multi-stage Dockerfiles with proper layer caching and .dockerignore
Persist database state safely using named Docker volumes
Orchestrate multi-container stacks (app + Postgres + Redis) with Docker Compose
